notes.title: Custom Scenario: The option to place countries under the control
notes.content:
Dear players,
We are excited to announce a new update that added into the custom scenario: the option to place countries under the control of a target country.

What does this mean?
You can select a target country and designate up to 10 countries to be under the conquest of that nation. This will lead to updates in world relations, as well as changes in the status of countries such as civilian populations, land ownership, and more.

Can you create alliances?
Yes you can create up to 5 alliances and name them.

Can you update the countries relations?
Yes you can update up to 10 relations.

Can you save and load the scenario?
Yes you can name and save & load the scenario after creating it.

In addition to this feature, we have made several other improvements:
* Enhanced game UI, speed, and stability.
* Updated armies, relations, and economies of many countries based on real-world data.
* Fixed reported issues and continue to improve Artificial Intelligence.

We plan to add countless new diplomacy & spies & war options, technologies, resources...
Your support is important to us to continue developing.
Thank you,
iGindis Team

notes.title: Custom Scenarios Option
notes.content:
Dear players,
A new feature is now available, allowing you to create your custom scenarios. Curious about how it works? These scenarios can be enjoyed in both single-player and local multiplayer modes, accommodating 2-8 players. Here's a breakdown of the key features:

Alliances:
* Form up to 5 alliances.
* Each alliance can consist of up to 30 countries.
* Personalize your alliance by assigning a name and specifying whether it's an economic or military alliance.

Relations:
* Manage up to 10 relations.
* For each relation, choose the target country and adjust relations with up to 10 other countries.
* Define the nature of each relation, ranging from war to alliance.

Save/Load Custom Scenario:
* The system allows you to save up to 10 custom scenarios.
* Name your scenarios for easy reference.
* Reload and replay your saved scenarios whenever you wish.

We plan to introduce numerous new options for diplomacy, spies, war options, technologies, resources, and world events.  
The more support we will get from our players the more we will do.
Your support is important to us to continue developing.
Thank you,
iGindis Team

notes.title: New option - Alliances
notes.content:
Dear players,‎
We added a new alliances option.

How will it work?
At the start of the game you can select and create a custom scenario.

Set alliances
* You can create up to 5 alliances.
* You can name the alliance and select up to 30 countries for each alliance.
* You can select the alliance type: Economic, Military
* Economy alliance will increase all countries' diplomacy level to excellent cooperation.
* Military alliance will increase all countries' diplomacy level to be allies.
* Countries can be selected in multiple alliances.
It means the USA can be in a military alliance with Japan and Korea in a unique alliance and Nato countries can be in a unique alliance.
* Once the game starts the system will make all the countries you selected as allies.

* Updated countries data based on real world events.‎
* Improved game UI, Speed, accessibility and stability.‎ ‎

notes.title: Added new long term country missions
notes.content:
Dear players,
Added a new option in the game name Missions.
Long term country missions can cause big world effects once completed.‎
You can invest in long term missions that if successful will make your country gain a lot of money, ‎civilians, and technological power.‎

Every mission has a different effect on your country and the world.‎
You can invest in one option every turn and the cost will be friendly to all countries.
The mission updates will appear in the general news when the turn will pass.

Success rate
Once you invest in a mission your chance of success will improve by your science technology levels.
For example if your science technology levels are 3 and you decide to research quantum computers. So the first try chance of success will be 4/7500 and next try will be 7/7500
The more missions your country will do the more chances it will succeed.

Long term missions
‎* Research Quantum Computers
Cost: $50,000,000
Chance to succeed 1/7,500
If your country successfully completes the mission:
The Science and Counter Espionage technologies in your country will be at max level.

‎* Space colonization of the moon‎
Cost: $50,000,000 + 1,000 civilians + 1,000 troops
Chance to succeed 1/200,000
If your country successfully completes the mission:
The Space, Robotics and Robots technologies in your country will be at max level.
Also your country will get 100,000 Anti Ballistic Missiles

* Detect life in space
Cost: $10,000,000
Chance to succeed 1/1,000,000
If your country successfully completes the mission:
The Biological, Chemical and Space technologies in your country will be at max level.
All world countries will improve relations with your country by 5 levels.

‎* Search for the Lost Ark of the Covenant
Cost: $25,000,000 + 1,000 civilians
Chance to succeed 1/1,000,000
If your country successfully completes the mission:
100 million civilians and 10 million troops will join your country.
Also troops technology in your country will be at max level.
All world countries that are not at war with your country will be your allies.

‎* Search for ancient alien technology
Cost: $25,000,000 + 1,000 troops
Chance to succeed 1/1,000,000
If your country successfully completes the mission:
The Education, Energy and Military Industry technologies in your country will be at max level.

‎* Build a space station‎
Cost: $50,000,000 + 1,000 civilians
Chance to succeed 1/15,000
If your country successfully completes the mission:
The Industry and Jets technologies in your country will be at max level.
Also your country will get 100,000 Ballistic Missiles.

* Research the human genome
Cost: $10,000,000 + 500 civilians
Chance to succeed 1/10,000
If your country successfully completes the mission:
The Agriculture technologies in your country will be at max level.
Also your country will clone 50 million civilians

* Research Artificial Intelligence
Cost: $25,000,000
Chance to succeed 1/5,000
If your country successfully completes the mission:
Will add 10 levels to the following technologies: Education, Agriculture, Science, Industry, Espionage, Counter Espionage and Robots.

* Search for deep ocean treasures
Cost: $10,000,000
Chance to succeed 1/1,000
If your country successfully completes the mission:
Your country will find treasures value from $100,000,000 to $50,000,000,000

* Search for holy artifacts
Cost: $10,000,000 + 100 troops
Chance to succeed 1/100,000
If your country successfully completes the mission:
Your country will get $2,000,000,000 extra money from world tourists every turn that passes.
All world countries will improve relations with your country by 3 levels.

* Research teleportation
Cost: $50,000,000 + 2,500 troops
Chance to succeed 1/500,000
If your country successfully completes the mission:
The Espionage and Sea Invasion technologies in your country will be at max level.
Also your country will get $10,000,000,000 extra money every turn that passes from using the technology in the civilian industry.

* Research self-replicating machines
Cost: $25,000,000
Chance to succeed 1/250,000
If your country successfully completes the mission:
The Robotics and Robots technologies in your country will be at max level.
Also will join your army 100,000 Fighting Robots

notes.title: Added Online Multiplayer (2-8 Players)
notes.content:
Dear players,  ‎
We are glad to announce that our games now support online multiplayer.‎ (Android/IOS/PC) 

You can test your leadership skills against real humans from around the world.‎
The games fully support accessibility and can be played in more than 35 languages. 
Also the game has an automatic translated messages system that will help you communicate with other players from around the world. (Our goal is that you will find new friends from around the world and improve your ‎leadership skills) ‎
Please see the tutorial that explains everything about the online multiplayer.‎

Online multiplayer: how will it work? 
Creator of the world can define the following things: 
‎ 
‎1. Can define 2-8 human players that can play in the world. 
‎* You can play against other players from around the world. 
‎* You can add a password to the world for friends only. 
‎* You can see the worlds lobby and join/create to play in multiple worlds.‎ 
* You can filter the worlds by number of human players, scenario, turn time, win conditions, find by world number or worlds created by player number.
‎ 
2. Define the world rules:  
‎* United Nations Active/Not Active 
‎* Weapon of mass destruction Active/Not Active 
‎* Win conditions: x countries conquest, x turn to play, Eliminate all other humans...
‎ 
3. Define turn time: 72 hours, 48 hours, 24hours, 12 hours…(Fast or slow game) 

4. Every player can create one world and can join to play in 3 worlds. 
* If you love our games and what we are doing you can open an option in the extra screen that will allow you to create 3 worlds and join up to play in 12 worlds.
‎* In case you lose in the world you created you can create another one.‎
‎ 
‎5. All players select the country they wish to lead. 
* Only the world creator can start the game.
‎* When all players join the world and click ready, then a button will appear to start the game. 
* The turn time will start counting and the first player starts playing. ‎
* When you finish playing and click the pass turn the next player will play.‎

‎6. When player 1 starts to play you will see the turn time for the next player to play and once the timer ‎will end or in case the player finishes the turn the next player in line can play.  
Once the last player completes the turn then the turn will initiate and the AI will play also. 
Once the AI completes the actions player 1 will start again to play. 
‎
7. You can set notifications to your email when it's your turn to play or in case the world you created is full and ready to start.
* You will get notification once and you will not get more until you enter to play.
* By default all notifications are off to all and you will need to verify your email and activate it.
‎ 
8. You can contact other players in the game and send them private messages that will be automatically translated to their language. 
‎ 
‎9. You will see all the players in the world based on rank, wins, loses… 
You can contact them to invite them to your world or to join your friends list. 
‎ 
Are you ready to compete with other leaders from around the world? 

We plan to add countless new scenarios, diplomacy & spies & war options, technologies, ‎resources... ‎
The more support we will get from our players the more we will do. ‎
Your support is important to us to continue developing.‎ ‎
Thank you,‎  ‎
iGindis Team
